exposure: elective birth between 39 weeks and 0 days' and 39 weeks and 6 days' gestation vs expectant management
birth via induction of labor vs planned cesarean delivery among those born electively at 39 weeks' gestation
outcome: Childhood developmental vulnerability at school entry
cohort: 176,236 births linked to childhood developmental outcomes data from the Australian state of New South Wales
finding: Elective birth at 39 weeks' gestation was not associated with childhood developmental vulnerability.
mod_finding: Among those born electively at 39 weeks' gestation, birth after induction of labor or by elective cesarean delivery had similar developmental outcomes.
